He married Phoebe Carney , daughter of James Perry CARNEY and Harriett DURHAM, who was born 14 December, 1889. He is buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold., DE. Phoebe died on 14 May, 1966 in Fairfield, Cumberland Co., NJ and is buried at Gouldtown Memorial Park, Gouldtown, Cumberland Co., NJ.
